title: Local AI needs to be the norm
summary: This article argues for making local AI deployment the standard practice rather than relying on cloud-based AI services. It emphasizes the importance of privacy, accessibility, and reduced dependency on centralized services, advocating for a paradigm shift in how AI is consumed and deployed. The high engagement (1237 points, 518 comments) indicates this is a timely and debated topic in the tech community.
problem_solved: Addresses the over-reliance on cloud AI services and the associated privacy, cost, and accessibility concerns.
why_valuable: Promotes user sovereignty over data, reduces costs, and enables AI access in offline/low-connectivity scenarios.
